scope: P8 owned application manifests, scoped server grants, message actions and owner-only test invocation.
implemented: Migration 102 persists manifests, ordered message actions, scoped server installations and bounded invocation results.
Application owners can replace validated manifests with up to ten uniquely named actions and explicitly enable test mode.
A dedicated Manage Applications role permission gates server installation, grant updates and revocation without requiring full administrator access.
Grant scopes independently control message-content disclosure and response completion. Revocation removes membership/runtime routing and immediately blocks new and pending non-test invocations.
Server members discover only actions from active installations. Invocation additionally requires channel view and read permission and validates the message belongs to that server and channel.
Bot gateway delivery carries a bounded application-action invocation; only the target bot may complete it and callers poll only their own invocation.
Account settings expose manifest/action editing and owner-only test delivery. Server settings expose scoped installation/revocation. Channel message menus expose active application actions.
